integrity: Exact exhaustive enumeration of all 2441406 scalar-normalized ternary cubics, independently checked by projective-flag restriction coefficients. All 186000 equality equations partition into two explicitly generated full projective orbits; both orbit representatives are proved geometrically smooth by partial-derivative elimination. Computational evidence is finite exhaustive proof for this finite domain, not a theorem for other fields.
scientific_limitations: The exact bound and orbit classification concern ternary plane cubics over the field with five elements only; no extension to arbitrary finite fields is claimed. An earlier no-tangent-filling result alone does not imply the exact two-point deficit or equality classification. Possible prior unpublished finite-geometry tables remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp two-point tangent-coverage deficit for plane cubics over the field of five elements
